entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments: ¶The LORD reigns; Let the peoples tremble! He dwells [between] the cherubim; Let the earth be moved!

entries.title: Psalms 99:2
segments: The LORD [is] great in Zion, And He [is] high above all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments: Let them praise Your great and awesome name-He [is] holy.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: The King's strength also loves justice; You have established equity; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: Exalt the LORD our God, And worship at His footstool-He [is] holy.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: ¶Moses and Aaron were among His priests, And Samuel was among those who called upon His name; They called upon the LORD, and He answered them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; They kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: You answered them, O LORD our God; You were to them God-Who-Forgives, Though You took vengeance on their deeds.

entries.title: Psalms 99:9
segments: Exalt the LORD our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the LORD our God [is] holy.
